examples: The team became complacent after winning three games in a row and lost the next match badly.
تیم بعد از سه برد پیاپی خودخشنود شد و بازی بعدی را به‌شدت باخت.
Managers warned staff not to grow complacent just because sales were currently strong.
مدیران به کارکنان هشدار دادند که فقط به‌خاطر فروش فعلاً خوب، بیش از حد آسوده نشوند.
A complacent attitude toward safety procedures can lead to serious accidents at the factory.
یک نگرش بیش از حد آسوده نسبت به رویه‌های ایمنی می‌تواند به حوادث جدی در کارخانه منجر شود.
miniContext: Complacent describes a feeling of comfortable satisfaction that leads someone to stop trying hard or stay alert. Companies that become complacent about innovation often lose market share to newer competitors. Years of success had made the champion complacent, and he underestimated his next opponent.

examples: A wasp stung him on the arm while he was eating outside.
یک زنبور نیش‌دار هنگامی که او بیرون غذا می‌خورد، بازویش را نیش زد.
The children screamed and ran when a wasp flew into the picnic area.
بچه‌ها جیغ زدند و فرار کردند وقتی یک زنبور نیش‌دار وارد منطقه پیک‌نیک شد.
We found a wasp nest hidden under the roof of the shed.
ما یک لانه زنبور نیش‌دار را که زیر سقف انباری پنهان شده بود، پیدا کردیم.
miniContext: A wasp is a flying insect related to the bee, known for its painful sting and yellow-and-black markings. Unlike bees, a wasp can sting more than once without dying. In late summer, a single wasp nest near a house can grow to contain hundreds of insects.

examples: The hospital program aims to rehabilitate patients after serious injuries so they can walk again.
این برنامه بیمارستانی هدف دارد بیماران را بعد از آسیب‌های جدی بازپروری کند تا دوباره بتوانند راه بروند.
The city plans to rehabilitate the old factory building and turn it into apartments.
شهر قصد دارد ساختمان کارخانه قدیمی را بازسازی کند و آن را به آپارتمان تبدیل کند.
Some prisons focus on programs designed to rehabilitate offenders rather than simply punish them.
برخی زندان‌ها بر برنامه‌هایی تمرکز دارند که برای بازپروری مجرمان طراحی شده‌اند، نه صرفاً تنبیه آنها.
miniContext: To rehabilitate means to help someone or something return to a healthy, normal, or useful condition. Physical therapists work closely with patients to rehabilitate muscles weakened by long hospital stays. The organization raises money to rehabilitate injured wildlife before releasing the animals back into the wild.

examples: After serving ten years, he was released on parole for good behavior.
بعد از گذراندن ده سال، او به‌خاطر رفتار خوب با آزادی مشروط آزاد شد.
Breaking the rules of parole can send a person straight back to prison.
شکستن قوانین آزادی مشروط می‌تواند فرد را مستقیماً به زندان برگرداند.
The board denied his request for parole, citing concerns about public safety.
هیئت درخواست او برای آزادی مشروط را به‌دلیل نگرانی‌های مربوط به امنیت عمومی رد کرد.
miniContext: Parole is the early release of a prisoner under certain conditions, usually with ongoing supervision. A parole officer regularly checks in with former inmates to make sure they follow the agreed conditions. Many states consider good behavior and completed programs when deciding whether to grant parole.

examples: The climber scaled a nearly vertical cliff without any safety rope.
کوهنورد بدون هیچ طناب ایمنی از یک صخره تقریباً عمودی بالا رفت.
She drew a vertical line down the center of the page to divide it into two columns.
او یک خط عمودی وسط صفحه کشید تا آن را به دو ستون تقسیم کند.
The new skyscraper's vertical design makes it stand out among the shorter buildings nearby.
طراحی عمودی آسمان‌خراش جدید باعث می‌شود در میان ساختمان‌های کوتاه‌تر اطراف برجسته باشد.
miniContext: Vertical describes something oriented straight up and down, as opposed to horizontal. Engineers calculate how much weight a vertical support beam can hold before it bends. In the chart, the vertical axis represents sales figures while the horizontal axis represents months.

examples: A multitude of people gathered in the square to watch the fireworks.
تعداد بسیار زیادی از مردم در میدان جمع شدند تا آتش‌بازی را تماشا کنند.
The report lists a multitude of reasons why the project was delayed.
این گزارش تعداد بسیار زیادی از دلایل تأخیر پروژه را فهرست می‌کند.
Faced with a multitude of options, she struggled to decide which university to attend.
او در برابر تعداد بسیار زیادی از گزینه‌ها، برای انتخاب دانشگاهی که باید در آن تحصیل کند، دچار تردید شد.
miniContext: A multitude is a very large number of people or things considered together. The charity concert attracted a multitude of fans despite the freezing weather. Small businesses face a multitude of challenges, from rising costs to changing customer habits.

examples: The committee decided to nominate her for the award because of her years of volunteer work.
کمیته تصمیم گرفت او را به‌خاطر سال‌ها کار داوطلبانه‌اش برای جایزه نامزد کند.
Members of the club can nominate any candidate they believe deserves the leadership position.
اعضای کلوپ می‌توانند هر نامزدی را که فکر می‌کنند شایسته سمت رهبری است، نامزد کنند.
The film was nominated for several awards after its surprising success at the festival.
این فیلم بعد از موفقیت غیرمنتظره‌اش در جشنواره، برای چند جایزه نامزد شد.
miniContext: To nominate someone means to formally propose them as a candidate for a position, award, or honor. Each year, critics nominate their favorite films for the top industry award. Before the election, party members gather to nominate the person they want to represent them.

examples: The coach saw great potential in the young player and offered him a spot on the team.
مربی توانایی بالقوه زیادی در بازیکن جوان دید و جایی در تیم به او پیشنهاد داد.
Investors are drawn to startups with potential for rapid growth.
سرمایه‌گذاران به استارتاپ‌هایی با پتانسیل رشد سریع جذب می‌شوند.
Teachers often say that every student has the potential to succeed with the right support.
معلمان اغلب می‌گویند هر دانش‌آموزی با پشتیبانی مناسب توانایی بالقوه موفق شدن را دارد.
miniContext: Potential refers to the capacity to develop or achieve something in the future, even if it has not happened yet. Scouts travel across the country looking for young athletes who show real potential. A good mentor helps someone recognize and develop their own potential rather than simply giving instructions.

examples: The detective visited the morgue to examine the body before the autopsy began.
کارآگاه قبل از شروع کالبدشکافی به سردخانه رفت تا جسد را بررسی کند.
Hospital staff transferred the patient's body to the morgue shortly after midnight.
کارکنان بیمارستان جسد بیمار را کمی بعد از نیمه‌شب به سردخانه منتقل کردند.
In the crime novel, a key clue is discovered inside the city morgue.
در این رمان جنایی، یک سرنخ کلیدی داخل سردخانه شهر کشف می‌شود.
miniContext: A morgue is a place, usually in a hospital or city building, where dead bodies are kept before burial or cremation. Workers at the morgue must follow strict procedures to identify every body correctly. The newspaper's old archive room was so quiet that reporters nicknamed it the morgue.

examples: She seemed preoccupied during dinner and barely spoke a word.
او در طول شام ذهن‌مشغول به نظر می‌رسید و تقریباً هیچ کلمه‌ای حرف نزد.
He was too preoccupied with work to notice his daughter's birthday was coming up.
او آن‌قدر با کار ذهن‌مشغول بود که متوجه نشد تولد دخترش نزدیک است.
Parents can become preoccupied with their children's grades and forget to ask how they actually feel.
والدین می‌توانند آن‌قدر با نمرات فرزندانشان ذهن‌مشغول شوند که فراموش کنند بپرسند واقعاً چه حسی دارند.
miniContext: Preoccupied describes a state of being so absorbed in thought about one thing that you fail to notice everything else. Drivers who are preoccupied with their phones are far more likely to cause an accident. Her mind stayed preoccupied with the upcoming exam long after she had closed her books for the night.

examples: The old sofa's upholstery was torn, so they decided to have it replaced.
روکش مبلمان کاناپه قدیمی پاره شده بود، پس تصمیم گرفتند آن را تغییر دهند.
Spilled coffee left a dark stain on the car's leather upholstery.
ریختن قهوه لکه تاریکی روی روکش چرمی صندلی ماشین باقی گذاشت.
The shop specializes in repairing and replacing upholstery for antique chairs.
این مغازه تخصص در تعمیر و تغییر روکش مبلمان برای صندلی‌های عتیقه دارد.
miniContext: Upholstery refers to the fabric, padding, and covering used on furniture such as chairs and sofas. A good upholstery cleaner can remove most stains without damaging the fabric underneath. When buying a used car, it is worth checking the condition of the upholstery before agreeing on a price.

examples: His indifference to the team's complaints eventually caused several players to quit.
بی‌تفاوتی او نسبت به شکایت‌های تیم در نهایت باعث شد چند بازیکن کنار بروند.
The audience's indifference to the speech was obvious from how many people checked their phones.
بی‌تفاوتی حضار نسبت به سخنرانی از تعداد افرادی که گوشی‌هایشان را چک می‌کردند، واضح بود.
She responded to the insult with complete indifference, refusing to let it upset her.
او به آن توهین با بی‌تفاوتی کامل پاسخ داد و اجازه نداد آن ناراحتش کند.
miniContext: Indifference describes a lack of interest, concern, or sympathy toward something or someone. Climate scientists worry that public indifference is slowing down the push for stronger environmental policies. The manager's indifference toward employee feedback created a tense and unmotivated workplace.
